title: SAP BTP Integration Developer
summary: SAP BTP integration developers connect SAP systems such as S/4HANA with other SAP and non-SAP applications using SAP Integration Suite, SAP's cloud service for building message flows called iFlows. They sit in SAP integration teams with functional consultants and partner system owners, building mappings, scripts and APIs and fixing failed messages.
dailyDuties: Build iFlows from interface specs in SAP Integration Suite
Write Groovy scripts and XSLT or message mappings
Configure IDoc, SOAP, REST, OData and SFTP adapters
Set up destinations, credentials and certificates in BTP
Migrate older SAP PI/PO interfaces to the cloud
Monitor failed messages and fix production errors

skills.expectation: Build, deploy and monitor iFlows in SAP Integration Suite (Cloud Integration)
Write Groovy scripts for payload handling, headers and custom logic in iFlows
Build XSLT and message mappings and work with SOAP and XML payloads
Connect REST and OData APIs through HTTP and OData adapters
Integrate S/4HANA and ECC through IDocs, RFCs and BAPIs, including PI/PO migrations
Manage subaccounts, destinations and security material in the BTP cockpit
Agree interface specs with functional consultants and partner system teams
Publish and secure APIs with SAP API Management policies
Set up OAuth 2.0 and certificate-based authentication for interfaces
Read ABAP on the SAP side of an interface
Keep scripts and mappings under version control
Write interface technical specs and runbooks
Monitor failed messages and fix production integration errors
